title: Every-Change Versioning
description: Every-Change Versioning is a storage ability in the Infinite History Preservation database. Versions every single change, no matter how small. Each write creates a new version linked to its parent; nothing is overwritten. It takes writes and produces versions. Tunable parameters: per change. Guarantee: no write ever destroys history.

fields.mechanism: Each write creates a new version linked to its parent; nothing is overwritten.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Deduplicated Storage
description: Deduplicated Storage is a storage ability in the Infinite History Preservation database. Stores each unique chunk once across all of history. Content-defined chunking dedups across versions; storage grows with change, not time. It takes versions and produces chunks. Tunable parameters: dedup. Guarantee: identical content is never stored twice.

fields.mechanism: Content-defined chunking dedups across versions; storage grows with change, not time.
fields.guarantees: identical content is never stored twice

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Time-Travel Reads
description: Time-Travel Reads is a storage ability in the Infinite History Preservation database. Reads any version as of any past moment. Reads take a timestamp; the version active then is served. It takes timestamp and produces version. Tunable parameters: ms precision. Guarantee: reads never return the wrong version.

fields.mechanism: Reads take a timestamp; the version active then is served.
fields.guarantees: reads never return the wrong version

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Branching Timelines
description: Branching Timelines is a storage ability in the Infinite History Preservation database. Branches history for experiments without touching the main line. Branches fork from any version; merges reconcile back with conflicts shown. It takes version and produces branch. Tunable parameters: per branch. Guarantee: the main line is never rewritten.

fields.mechanism: Branches fork from any version; merges reconcile back with conflicts shown.
fields.guarantees: the main line is never rewritten

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Retention Forever
description: Retention Forever is a storage ability in the Infinite History Preservation database. Keeps versions forever by default with no expiry. No version is ever garbage-collected unless explicitly pruned by policy. It takes versions and produces kept. Tunable parameters: forever. Guarantee: pruning always needs explicit approval.

fields.mechanism: No version is ever garbage-collected unless explicitly pruned by policy.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Integrity Proofs
description: Integrity Proofs is a storage ability in the Infinite History Preservation database. Proves no version was tampered with, ever. Each version hashes its content and parent; the chain verifies end to end. It takes versions and produces proofs. Tunable parameters: hash chain. Guarantee: a broken link is always detectable.

fields.mechanism: Each version hashes its content and parent; the chain verifies end to end.
fields.guarantees: a broken link is always detectable

title: Blame Views
description: Blame Views is a storage ability in the Infinite History Preservation database. Shows who changed what and when across all of history. Each line's history is walkable back to its origin with author and time. It takes versions and produces blame. Tunable parameters: per line. Guarantee: blame never misattributes.

fields.mechanism: Each line's history is walkable back to its origin with author and time.

title: Diff Any Two
description: Diff Any Two is a storage ability in the Infinite History Preservation database. Diffs any two versions, however far apart. The diff engine handles million-version gaps with streaming. It takes versions and produces diff. Tunable parameters: any pair. Guarantee: diffs are always complete.

fields.mechanism: The diff engine handles million-version gaps with streaming.

title: Snapshot Tags
description: Snapshot Tags is a storage ability in the Infinite History Preservation database. Tags meaningful versions with human names. Tags like release-2.0 point at versions; tags are movable with history. It takes versions and produces tags. Tunable parameters: named. Guarantee: tags never lose their target.

fields.mechanism: Tags like release-2.0 point at versions; tags are movable with history.

title: Legal Hold
description: Legal Hold is a storage ability in the Infinite History Preservation database. Locks versions under legal hold against any deletion. Held versions ignore pruning policies until the hold releases. It takes hold and produces locked. Tunable parameters: per matter. Guarantee: holds are never bypassable.

fields.mechanism: Held versions ignore pruning policies until the hold releases.

title: Export Timeline
description: Export Timeline is a storage ability in the Infinite History Preservation database. Exports a full timeline as a portable archive. All versions with metadata export to a self-describing bundle. It takes history and produces bundle. Tunable parameters: portable. Guarantee: exports always verify on import.

fields.mechanism: All versions with metadata export to a self-describing bundle.

title: Storage Accounting
description: Storage Accounting is a storage ability in the Infinite History Preservation database. Accounts storage per version and per branch. Each version's marginal cost is computed from its unique chunks. It takes versions and produces costs. Tunable parameters: per version. Guarantee: accounting never double-counts shared chunks.

fields.mechanism: Each version's marginal cost is computed from its unique chunks.

title: Prune Policies
description: Prune Policies is a storage ability in the Infinite History Preservation database. Prunes only by explicit policy, never by age alone. Policies name what may go — e.g. unreferenced branches; prunes are logged. It takes policy and produces prunes. Tunable parameters: explicit. Guarantee: pruning is always reversible for 30 days.

fields.mechanism: Policies name what may go — e.g. unreferenced branches; prunes are logged.
fields.guarantees: pruning is always reversible for 30 days

title: History Search
description: History Search is a storage ability in the Infinite History Preservation database. Searches across all of history, not just the present. Every version's text is indexed; queries return version hits with dates. It takes versions and produces hits. Tunable parameters: full-text. Guarantee: search never misses an indexed version.

fields.mechanism: Every version's text is indexed; queries return version hits with dates.
fields.guarantees: search never misses an indexed version

title: Restore Points
description: Restore Points is a storage ability in the Infinite History Preservation database. Restores the whole system to any version in one action. Restore sets the live pointer to the chosen version; the current state becomes a version too. It takes version and produces restored. Tunable parameters: 1 action. Guarantee: restore never loses the pre-restore state.

fields.mechanism: Restore sets the live pointer to the chosen version; the current state becomes a version too.
fields.guarantees: restore never loses the pre-restore state
